title: Winter rapeseed varieties, lutos, irrigated, Banat plain
rationale: Irrigation removes the drought lever, so the only remaining discriminator is maturity_class read against the calendar. Every rapeseed window for the Banat closed before the case date — 'Câmpia Română și Câmpia Banatului' and 'estul, vestul și nordul țării' both end 09-10, the national hybrid window ends 08-31 — so any sowing here is already late, and the single semitardiv hybrid, Umberto KWS, is the worst fit for a late sowing; DK Exception is semitimpuriu and additionally recommended for all zones and all soil types. No topAny is asserted: LG Architect and LG Ambassador are semitimpuriu too, so three hybrids share the earliness argument and the dictionary does not choose between them.
